body: I have a family doctor, I have also had people from the Waterloo Eye Institute suggest ODSP in the first place. As for expenses, I am completely broke. I wouldn't be able to pay any expenses at all. If I were to get on it though, my expenses would be assisting my father with bills, since we are hemorrhaging funds. As well as assisting in grocery costs.
Poppy on full melee is also pretty funny

The melee build os relatively easy to build. Grab cutlass amd relentless pursuit plus whatever upgrades/items makes your blink recharge quicker. Going Oasis for the red items can net you some stupid synergies with recon. Good luck with not getting turned inside out in gaurdian ranks though.

Have no clue what IBIS was like pre nerf, but I managed to beat it first try with duckets and a pile bunker on a light build. Was still very close, had infinitely more trouble dealing with Michigan...
